_help.about: Outdoor rooms (design 30 Sept §BB): corridor -> threshold -> reveal. Rooms hang off the road network where it widens; the understory at eye level makes the walls; one feature per room; the sky through a gap. Restart after editing.
_help.walls: Understory height band that counts as a wall; the band along a room's edge and a corridor's sides where understory density is scaled up; the room floor's density scale-down.
_help.reveal: After this much corridor a reveal is due, at these places; past vista_impostors_from_m the view is pictures and far shell only.
_help.test: tools/look/measure_look.py sky-share: inside a room most directions read under sky_share_room_max and the door reads over sky_share_door_min.
